THINGS_SURRENDER.title: Surrender
THINGS_SURRENDER.description:
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
Change the enemy's intent to apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
THINGS_REUSE.title: Reuse
THINGS_REUSE.description: The first time you draw a Status each turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] it into [gold]Fuel[/gold] and add a [gold]Soot[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THINGS_SOULFYSH_DISEASE.title: Soulfysh Disease
THINGS_SOULFYSH_DISEASE.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Soulfysh Disease[/gold].
When played via [gold]Sly[/gold], add a copy of this card and {BeckonCount:inverseDiff()} [purple]Disperse[/purple] [gold]{BeckonCount:plural:Beckon|Beckons}[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THINGS_RECALL.title: Reminisce
THINGS_RECALL.description: This turn, draw cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] first.
THINGS_PACK_UP.title: Pack Up
THINGS_COLLISION.title: Collision
THINGS_COLLISION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
You and the enemy each lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THINGS_LEECH_PARASITE.title: Parasitism
THINGS_LEECH_PARASITE.description: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], ALL Sanguine Leeches gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regen[/gold] and {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THINGS_SNAIL_CRYSTAL_CHIP.title: Crystal Chip
THINGS_CAVE_GOD_BROKEN_BLADE_TRIAL.title: Broken Blade
THINGS_CAVE_GOD_BROKEN_BLADE_TRIAL.descr: You cannot play Attacks this turn.
THINGS_CAVE_GOD_SHATTERED_SHIELD_TRIAL.d: You cannot play Skills this turn.
THINGS_STICKY_BEESWAX.title: Sticky Beeswax
THINGS_STICKY_BEESWAX.description: Whenever you draw this card, increase the cost of another random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] by {Energy:energyIcons()} this turn.
THINGS_LAMENT_TEAR.title: Lament Tear
THINGS_LAMENT_TEAR.description: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] while Lament Visage is alive, gain {ThingsLamentSorrowPower:diff()} [gold]Lamentation[/gold].
